title: Enhance pip install commands
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

PyTorch docs currently target `pip[3]`..., whereas many Python docs elsewhere recommend `python[3] -m pip`...

https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/

### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

Replace pip3 with python 3 -m pip
